subject: dsa
title: Binary Search
summary: Track a range [lo, hi]. Compare the middle element to the target; the result tells you which half to throw away. Repeat on the surviving half until it collapses.
problem: Return the index of target in a sorted array, or report that it isn't present.

steps.caption: Find 5 in this sorted array — without checking every cell.
The answer, if any, lies in [lo, hi] — the whole array to start.
Middle is index 2 (value 3). 3 < 5, so 5 must be to the right. Drop the left half.
Middle is index 4 (value 9). 9 > 5, so 5 is to the left. Drop the right half.
Range collapses to index 3 — value 5. Match! Found at index 3, in just 3 probes.
